a.lede: DeepMind researchers were able to formally verify that the widely used encryption protocol works as intended. Their stretch goal? Do the same for “all the software of the world.”
a.title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure

b.lede: The four-week project hints that AI could make formal verification far more practical.
b.title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
